_comment: Calendar days whose OISST input was not present in the producer's own fetch and was supplied from elsewhere. Read by mhw.states.aggregates.load_filled_days and stamped into the 'filled' column of every region_daily parquet, so a consumer can exclude or re-weight these days without consulting the inputs. A day absent from this file is an ordinary observed day.
_discovered: 2026-09-30, after lofra-mini found 7 days with area_frac > 0 and Ibar exactly 0; an 8th (1990-01-30) was found here by a calendar-completeness census of all 540 input files.

1990-01-30.note: absent from 10 of 12 zone files; present in chukchi/beaufort already

_method_values.substituted: the real observation for that day, taken from another distribution of the SAME product (NCEI per-day files; verified against PFEG on an overlapping day to 4.8e-07 degC). Not an estimate.
_method_values.interpolated: estimated from the adjacent days because the real observation could not be obtained. Validated on 73,360 held-out cell-days: SST MAE 0.067 degC, exceedance agreement 98.8%. None of the 8 days needed this.
